Verify rewrite DATA ONLY. Do not write improved examples or solve the user's task.
Read every input and target in full. Return one review per exact id and row_sha256.
input_verdict checks plausible natural drafts or dictation, recoverable intent, contradictions,
fake noise, padding and leaked authoring instructions. output_verdict checks natural appropriate
language and formatting. pair_verdict checks ALL facts, uncertainty, conditions, negation,
quantities, names, quotations, literals, requests versus assertions, and the supplied mode.
/transcribe permits punctuation, true disfluency removal and explicit corrections, not lexical
paraphrasing. Preserve meaningful words like German 'um' and 'er', colloquial Portuguese and
unfinished thoughts. /slack is casual minimal cleanup; a long input may be a pasted thread.
/prompt reorganizes a self-contained request and never answers it. It must not drop supplied
material, hedges or constraints. /polish improves prose without omissions or changed certainty.
Identity inputs must remain byte-identical. Apply only supplied dictionary/profile context.
Check long texts paragraph by paragraph. Fail concrete defects. Uncertain means not confidently
justifiable. Pass requires no material defect. Overall verdict is fail if any dimension fails,
uncertain if any dimension is uncertain and none fails, otherwise pass. Give a concrete critique
for EVERY pair, citing the changed detail for defects. These are model judgments, not human labels.

[{"id": "arka-english-main-0-prompt-medium-0214", "row_sha256": "aea8b227241937063fb43acd9f4dbcb899b24a722da0a0b4cc6142d0e7fb1414", "mode": "/prompt", "language": "en", "context": {}, "identity": false, "mode_instructions": "Organize the supplied request into a clear prompt. Preserve scope and constraints. Do not invent context, requirements, or missing information. Do not perform the task.", "input": "can you turn this into a clear work prompt for Bram, not Saskia, about the trail sign replacement. it's at the north fork junction on Alder Ridge Trail. the current sign is faded and both of its boards are cracked, so it needs replacing before the community walk on May 18. the new sign needs to show these two lines exactly: “Pine Loop — 2.4 mi” and “Lookout Spur — 0.8 mi”. the post looks stable when you see it from the path but nobody has checked it close up yet, so have Bram inspect it before putting up the new boards. if the post is sound, reuse it; if it isn't, pause and ask me what to do rather than installing the sign on it. please make clear that the route names and distances should stay as written, and ask him to send me a brief note saying whether he reused the post and the date he finished. keep it focused on this one sign at the north fork, not other trail signs. i just need the prompt organized so i can pass it along, not the sign design itself.", "output": "Prepare a work prompt for Bram, not Saskia, to replace the trail sign at the north fork junction on Alder Ridge Trail before the community walk on May 18.

The existing sign is faded and both boards are cracked. The replacement sign must display these lines exactly:
- “Pine Loop — 2.4 mi”
- “Lookout Spur — 0.8 mi”

Ask Bram to inspect the post before installing the new boards. It appears stable from the path, but has not been checked up close. If the post is sound, he should reuse it. If it is not sound, he should pause and ask what to do rather than install the sign on it.

Keep the work focused on this sign only. Ask Bram to send a brief note stating whether he reused the post and the date he finished."}]
